title: 댕댕이 인스타
suno_analysis_sp: K-Pop bubblegum pop track featuring bright, clean electric guitar strumming and a syncopated bassline. The arrangement uses a crisp acoustic drum kit with a tight snare and prominent hi-hats. Male vocals are delivered in a melodic, rhythmic style with occasional harmonies. The production is polished with light compression and subtle reverb on the vocals. Key of G Major, 128 BPM.

[bright electric guitar strumming, syncopated bass]
